summary: I know I am supposed to tell you not to just go on the literary element scavenger hunt, where you make one poem with a simile,one with a metaphor, one with alliteration. Yet #edu307 I have fond memories of doing this in 6th grade. I typed them up on a half tuypewriter/half word processor thing and colored each page.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I know I am supposed to tell you not to just go on the literary element scavenger hunt, where you make one poem with a simile,one with a metaphor, one with alliteration. Yet #edu307 I have fond memories of doing this in 6th grade. I typed them up on a half tuypewriter/half word processor thing and colored each page.
